newsitem.title: USA: Nu Skin files for 7.0 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Nu Skin files for 7.0 mln shr offering.

text.p: Nu Skin Asia Pacific Inc said Thursday it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer seven million common shares to the public.
Nu Skin said certain shareholders and "entities formed primarily for estate planning and charitable purposes" would offer the shares.
"The offered shares will be converted from Class B to Class A concurrent with the offering," it said.
Merrill Lynch & Co, Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter, Nomura Securities International Inc and PaineWebber Inc will be the managing underwriters, it added.
The company is a network marketing company that distributes and sells personal care and nutrition products in Asia.
It has more than 83 million shares in circulation.
